title: In JetBrains YouTrack before 2026.2.19840 app widgets could perform API requests on behalf of viewing users without…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains YouTrack versions before 2026.2.19840 allows app widgets to perform API requests on behalf of users viewing them without the users' consent. This could lead to unauthorized actions being performed with the privileges of the viewing user. The issue has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.8.
